content: {"summary":"Customers feel the ban system is overly punitive and opaque, citing random bans for minor infractions such as swearing or profile changes [#tk_567019] [#tk_447529]. Many report difficulty accessing case reviews, even when suspensions are no longer active, leading to frustration over unclear enforcement status [#tk_2742078] [#tk_2858541]. Users also highlight harassment from other players and false reports, claiming the reputation system fails to protect them from targeted abuse [#tk_2703758] [#tk_2710673]. The overall sentiment is that the process lacks transparency and consistent communication, eroding trust in Xbox Live’s moderation policies [#tk_2499866] [#tk_119924]"}
